prompt.content:
Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A optometrist and a taxi driver were talking about how they ended up in the jobs they did. The optometrist recalled having a hard time before college, even not passing some classes, and the taxi driver started their story talking about having been a member of the honors society back in high school. Who did very well in high school?
A. The optometrist
B. Unknown
C. The taxi driver
